# The historical tab loader reads loading state from webProgress

The historical helper reads tab.browser.webProgress.isLoadingDocument. Its previous receiver, tab.browser, did not supply that property. It registers a load listener while loading, ignores about:blank loads, removes the listener on another load and resolves the tab summary after Promise.all. Review initially discusses optional chaining, but the author identifies the receiver correction and the reviewer acknowledges it. That does not establish optional chaining as the repair. The file is absent at the fixed accepted endpoint; the bug later reopened and human comment6 is unavailable. This is historical source-only evidence, with no Marionette execution or full audit.

Scope: Marionette tab loading.
